filters.kept: results announcements (Final / Interim / Quarterly Results); annual, interim and quarterly reports; business and trading updates; inside information and profit alerts; discloseable / major / very substantial / connected and continuing connected transactions (incl. their completion and update notices); transaction circulars; voluntary announcements filed under 'Other - Miscellaneous' whose title is about the business (launches, agreements, orders, capacity, customers); a listing prospectus (global offering)
filters.skipped: monthly returns, next day disclosure returns, proxy forms, constitutional documents, documents on display, debt notices, pre-listing drafts; overseas regulatory announcements (copies of A-share filings); dividends, board / personnel, governance, shareholder meetings and their notices, share schemes, financing / share capital, buybacks, trading / listing admin, clarifications, litigation, board-meeting dates; procedural circulars; ESG reports; and, by title, treasury investments (wealth management), loans / guarantees / deposit services, H-share full circulation, share awards, index inclusion — never silently (reason per document)
filters.first_sync: 120 days, plus the company's newest annual report from up to 400 days back
filters.language: the English version (HKEXnews English section); the Chinese file only when no English one exists
filters.duplicates: a document already saved under transcripts/ by hand or by ir_pull.py (same HKEXnews file number in its SOURCE line), or the same PDF bytes, is not saved again
